The exact division is:

\[
815472 \div 123 = 6629 \text{ remainder } 105
\]

because \(123 \times 6629 = 815367\) and \(815472 - 815367 = 105\).

So:

\[
? = \frac{815472}{123} = 6629 + \frac{105}{123} = 6629\frac{35}{41} = \frac{271824}{41}
\]

Thus there is no integer divisor; the exact divisor is:

\[
\boxed{\frac{271824}{41}}
\]
